reason: The label is exactly what I look for: no sweeteners, no preservatives, real caffeine. But on about 17,000 CZK a month I can't put 649 CZK into twelve cans of something I've never tasted, when I can brew my own mate before a night shift for a few crowns.
objection: 54 CZK a can is a luxury for me, and the English label makes me wonder if it's really Czech or just marketed as Czech. I'd want to taste it before committing to a 12-pack.
would_change_my_mind: Trying a free can at a launch event, or being able to buy a 4-pack or single cans on Rohlík's bio section for around 35-40 CZK a can.
